title: Move the order to another stage
summary: Skip stages, go back (for example, from the try-in back to the lab for an adjustment) or close the order, such as cancelling it.

steps.title: Menu → Clinic History → Lab Orders
steps.details: The jobs sent to external labs and the stage each one is in.

steps.title: Search for the order
steps.details: Search by patient, job, lab or order number.

steps.title: Open the order
steps.details: Click it in the list. Its details open on the right.

steps.title: Choose the stage
steps.details: All stages except the current one, in order. To a final stage, like Completed or Cancelled, it moves without asking.

steps.title: Lab
steps.details: Only if it has no lab yet. If only one lab does that job, it comes preselected.

steps.title: Due date
steps.details: It comes proposed from the stage’s time limit, and the shortcuts change it with one click. If the date passes and it has not arrived, the order becomes overdue.

steps.title: Confirm the stage change
steps.details: It opens below, in the same panel. Clicking the button saves the change.

steps.title: Stage history
steps.details: Every change is recorded: who made it, when, and how long it was in the previous stage.
